versions.changelog:
v2v 1.0.0 - Initial placeholder release

- Introduced as a placeholder skill for video-to-video (v2v) workflows on skills.video.
- Clearly notifies users that v2v functionality is not yet implemented.
- Avoids guessing request structure or API parameters—does not support real v2v requests yet.
- Recommends checking for model-specific documentation if required.
- Will be updated to a full workflow once an API contract is available.
- Related placeholder skills referenced: video-generation, i2v, i2i.
